description_en: Supports structured recognition and output of key fields, such as invoice code, invoice number, seller name, seller tax identification number, purchaser name, purchaser tax identification number, and total amount
description_zh: 支持包括发票代码、发票号码、销售方名称、销售方识别号、购买方名称、购买方识别号、合计金额等关键字段结构化识别输出
kebab_example: aliyun ocr-api recognize-common-printed-invoice --url 'https://img.alicdn.com/imgextra/i2/O1CN01XU9dTh1O4CdHxXhMw_!!6000000001651-0-tps-1437-909.jpg' --biz-body '图片二进制' --region cn-hangzhou
name: RecognizeCommonPrintedInvoice

parameters.help_en: Image URL (length must not exceed 2048 bytes; Base64 is not supported)
parameters.help_zh: 图片链接（长度不超2048字节，不支持 base64）
parameters.name: url

parameters.help_en: Image binary byte stream, maximum size 10 MB
parameters.help_zh: 图片二进制字节流，最大10MB
parameters.name: body

Code.description_en: Error code (this field is not returned if recognition succeeded)
Code.description_zh: 错误码（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）

Message.description_en: Error message (this field is not returned if recognition succeeded)
Message.description_zh: 错误提示（如果识别成功，不会返回此字段）
Message.example: You are not authorized to perform this operation.
